title: PricingPlans
description: Component used to present several pricing plans side by side, one of them optionally recommended

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: Whether the plans share the available width equally, or fill the row at their own minimum width

plan.title: Plans
plan.description: The plans to present, in the order they should be read

price.title: Price
price.description: Price of the plan, e.g. "$99" or "On request"

pricePeriod.title: Price period
pricePeriod.description: The period the price refers to, e.g. "per month". Leave empty for a one-off price

description.title: Description
description.description: Short description of what the plan is for and who it suits

badge.title: Badge
badge.description: Optional badge above the plan name, e.g. "Popular". Leave empty for no badge

highlight.title: Highlight
highlight.description: Present this plan as the recommended one, on an inverted surface

cta.title: Call to action
cta.description: The button that starts this plan

label.title: Label
label.description: Text content to display inside the button

url.title: URL
url.description: The URL to link to when the button is clicked

variant.title: Variant
variant.description: Variant of the button. Defaults to `primary` on a highlighted plan and `tertiary` on a regular one

featureListTitle.title: Feature list title
featureListTitle.description: Heading above the list of what the plan includes

featureList.title: Included features
featureList.description: What the plan includes, one entry per line

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: Optional icon in front of the entry, e.g. "check". Leave empty for a plain list
